description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to organization ID generation and decryption, using the CryptoJS library. It handles encryption of normalized emails to generate organization IDs and includes a decryption function for debugging purposes. It also validates the tenant salt used in cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId
methods.description: Generates an organization ID by encrypting a normalized email with a tenant-specific salt using AES-128-ECB and encoding the result for URL transmission.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId
methods.description: Decrypts an organization ID from its URL-encoded form back to the original email, primarily for debugging.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt is set and non-empty.
